description: Source code for controlling a stepper motor in an embedded system, including initialization, position saving/loading, and movement control.

classes.name: StepperMotor
classes.description: Class representing a stepper motor with methods for initialization, movement, and position management.

methods.name: saveStepperPos
methods.description: Saves the current stepper position to backup memory.

methods.name: loadStepperPos
methods.description: Loads the stepper position from backup memory.

methods.name: stThread
methods.description: Thread function controlling the stepper motor movement based on target position.

methods.name: StepperMotor::StepperMotor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stepper motor object.

methods.name: StepperMotor::getTargetPosition
methods.description: Returns the target position of the stepper motor.

methods.name: StepperMotor::setTargetPosition
methods.description: Sets the target position for the stepper motor.

methods.name: StepperMotor::setDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction of the stepper motor movement.

methods.name: StepperMotor::pulse
methods.description: Pulses the stepper motor to move one step.

methods.name: StepperMotor::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the stepper motor with hardware pins and parameters.
